Glance 2026.07.27 adds modular complex-format support, richer folder navigation, and new Adobe and 3D previews.

## Highlights

- Navigate into files and nested folders directly from folder previews with Space or double-click, then return with Escape while preserving selection and scroll position.
- Show configurable media information in the footer, including image bit depth, without collecting metadata when the field is disabled.
- Install Office, Adobe, and 3D support as isolated optional components, selected by default in the installer and reported in Settings.
- Preview Photoshop documents progressively from embedded thumbnails to high-resolution results, and preview PDF-compatible Illustrator files without requiring Adobe applications.
- Preview common 3D mesh formats and STEP, IGES, and BREP CAD files with interactive orbit, pan, zoom, grid, and wireframe controls.
- Reset PDF and converted document zoom and scroll position when switching files.

## Release contents

- `Glance-Setup-2026.07.27-x64.exe`: Recommended installer containing the core application and selectable optional components. All components are selected by default.
- `Glance-2026.07.27-x64.zip`: Portable core application without optional components.
- `Glance-Component-<Name>-2026.07.27-x64.zip`: Standalone optional component. Use only the package from the same Glance release, extract it into the application's `components` directory, and restart Glance.
- `Glance-2026.07.27-x64-symbols.zip`: Debug symbols for diagnostics and crash analysis.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: SHA-256 checksums for every release asset.
